_why: The device server this app carries inside itself.
ForgeFX is a separate project (MIT, sKuhLight) and we ship a copy of it in the
installer, so what goes in has to be a fixed thing rather than whatever its
default branch says today. `tag` is what a person reads; `commit` is what is
actually checked, because a tag can be moved and a commit cannot.
forgefx-midi is the preset codec ForgeFX depends on. Its ref is not ours to
choose: ForgeFX pins its own sibling in stack.lock.json for exactly the tag
builds we are copying, so scripts/vendor-forgefx.mjs cross-checks the tag
below against that file and refuses to build a pair upstream never released
